title: FixCandidate
description: One frozen change that fixes a work item: what it changes, what it builds, the tests that ran, and where the change waits for review. An approval binds `outputsDigest` and the head of the change, so that a new commit makes a new candidate.

component.description: The name of the component that the change fixes.

method.description: How the change fixes the component, for example `lockfile`, `overlay`, `graft`, `patch` or the name of a change written by hand.

approvalsNeeded.description: The roles that must approve the candidate.

files.description: The files that the change touches, relative to the repository root.

sourceHash.description: The hash of the source tree with the change, as the build tool writes it (for example the Nix narHash).

outputs.description: The build outputs, by application and then by output name (for example `package` or `image`).

outputsDigest.description: The digest that approvals bind: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of `outputs` (keys sorted, no white space, UTF-8), or of the patch bytes for a candidate with no build outputs.

tests.description: The builds and tests that ran on the candidate. An empty list means that none ran.

rationale.description: Why the change fixes the work item: what was wrong, what the change does, and how that closes it.

provedAt.description: When the check of the finding ran again against the change and no longer matched. Absent when the change was never executed.

changeRef.title: ChangeRef
changeRef.description: Where the change is. `pull_request`: a pull request or merge request on a Git server. `commit`: a commit on a branch. `patch`: a unified diff with no commit yet.

testRun.title: TestRun
testRun.description: One build, test or smoke check that ran on the candidate.
